principles: The shell never executes arbitrary commands or manifest-provided shell strings.
Intent actions are limited to a reviewed local allowlist and require explicit approval.
Unconfigured capabilities default to denied in the shell preference profile.
File inspection and hashing run locally; uploads are not performed by the shell.
A UI control is not evidence that a kernel, driver, updater, model or runtime is connected.
The Russian locale is the default shell language; Ukrainian is a first-class peer interface locale with local command aliases.
Deep-time epochs use arbitrary-precision integer values and never replace civil wall-clock time.
CRC32 checks detect accidental local snapshot corruption only; they are not signatures or proof of origin.
A browser update preview cannot change boot entries, partitions, kernel state or drivers.

desktop.scope: browser shell, responsive layout, draggable windows, dock, seven original app panels and seven system tools

intent_ui.scope: offline allowlisted actions, preview and explicit confirmation

local_ai_and_npu.scope: no local model runtime, NPU enumeration or kernel scheduling

approval_zones.scope: Mora intent actions only; system-level approvals require native broker

immutable_updates.scope: Mora preferences have versioned integrity envelopes and Restore can display a gated A/B plan; no signed OS image updater, boot-slot switch or system rollback is connected

app_sandboxing.scope: policy documented; browser prototype does not sandbox native processes

zero_trust_permissions.scope: deny-by-default shell preferences; no kernel enforcement

provenance.scope: local SHA-256; C2PA signature and manifest verification absent

adaptive_workspace.scope: responsive browser layout, RU/UK locale switch, local app command palette, keyboard navigation and reduced motion; native compositor, XR session transfer and OS-wide speech remain absent

multimodal_input.scope: keyboard, pointer and touch; no voice or spatial input service

material_interface.scope: one DuckOS black/white/yellow palette, near-black radial workspace, restrained folds, soft neutral glass, readable Cyrillic fallback stack and reduced-motion-aware transitions

compatibility.scope: Read-only PE32/PE32+ header, section and import-DLL inspection; isolated prefix scaffolding and CLI launch diagnostics; no native NT/Win32 process runtime, DirectX translation or Windows execution

declarative_configuration.scope: versioned local shell preferences; no full OS desired-state manager

accessibility.scope: keyboard command surface, locale-aware labels, responsive layout and reduced-motion support; complete screen-reader audit and native accessibility services remain

energy_awareness.scope: user-selectable shell preference only; no CPU/GPU power scheduler or VRR control

shared_design_system.scope: versioned single Duck palette, geometry, spacing, typography and motion tokens with Segoe UI/Noto Sans/Arial fallbacks and explicit RU/UK coverage; native toolkit adapters remain distinct

installable_workspace.scope: web manifest and scoped offline cache; not an OS installer

gaming_performance.scope: Mora Boost links to OPlague's Windows workbench; no direct browser PCI, GPU, driver or power-plan access

desktop_optimizer.scope: native Python user-space utility for read-only desktop/process audit, reversible current-user startup management and confirmed move-to-Inbox; no native compositor, virtual desktop manager, kernel scheduler or machine-wide service control

language_runtime.scope: browser shell Russian default and persistent Ukrainian locale; local command palette, translated shell labels and Ukrainian aliases for allowlisted intent actions; complete native text-to-speech and OS-wide locale services are not connected

deep_time_model.scope: separate BigInt epoch-year model with bounded decimal parsing and comparison; civil date/time remains sourced from the host clock

recovery_integrity.scope: versioned Mora preference snapshots wrapped in canonical UTF-8 envelopes with CRC32 corruption detection and previous-generation linkage; no signed OS image or cryptographic provenance claim

state_branching.scope: local Mora settings branches with parent lineage and CRC32 validation; branch storage is bounded to the latest 12 entries and is not a filesystem snapshot

atomic_update_plan.scope: testable A/B inactive-slot plan with signature, compatibility and capacity gates; plan-only contract with no updater, boot manager or system image writer

diagnostics_contract.scope: bounded structured local diagnostic record schema with component, severity, locale and recovery action; native kernel journal and process-wide error aggregation remain absent
